title: ResolveAI incident investigation studio

tests.name: Complete backend suite
tests.conditions: 151 tests passed against disposable PostgreSQL/Redis on isolated loopback ports. Includes canonical semantic validation and immutable historical recordings.

tests.name: Real HTTP simulator boundary
tests.conditions: Nine local HTTP runs: two inputs repeated, four controlled faults, cancellation, canonical result/event semantics, cookie ownership and SSE/poll replay. All actual provider calls are zero.

tests.name: Frontend build
tests.conditions: TypeScript, 7 event checks, 11 outcome checks, 165 historical assertions, 44 diagrams, full app/widget builds and widget lifecycle checks.

tests.name: Built widget warning display
tests.command: CUA: connector timeout, visible canonical JSON, technical explanations and 375px mobile inspection
tests.conditions: Local built widget displays retained diagnostics with SUCCEEDED and errors empty. No console warning/error observed. Not a public Portfolio deployment check. Visual capture is a5b62d2; widget/application source is byte-identical in final b65b9ad. Final HTTP checks were repeated.

tests.name: Source and architecture checks
tests.command: Ruff, mypy, architecture consistency/history and widget admission regression
tests.conditions: Application 0.3.5 and architecture 2.0.7; ten prior architecture snapshots preserved. Source-hygiene check is recorded separately at commit time.

tests.name: Release image and public deployment
tests.conditions: Pinned 0.3.5 image deployed to the public demonstration host; 68 HTTPS checks and production widget browser verification passed. No external provider calls or private service integration.

tests.name: Real cross-service edges
tests.conditions: FlowOps failure ingestion, authorized KnowledgeOps lookup, live AgentOps inference/usage and investigation-completed delivery remain unimplemented or stubbed.

costs.method: All nine actual local HTTP runs reported zero provider calls and NONE cost. Hosting and development costs are not allocated.

limits: Public 0.3.5 synthetic sandbox and shared widget verified; exact-image vulnerability scanning, live inference and production capacity benchmarking NOT RUN.
Canonical simulator boundary only; no real FlowOps, KnowledgeOps or AgentOps service-to-service edge is connected.
Single-process temporary sessions/runs; restart invalidates them. No durable public admission or remediation.
Synthetic rule outcomes do not measure live-model performance, real diagnostic accuracy or production capacity.
Historical backend recordings preserve original 0.3.0 versions and byte hashes; they are compatibility artifacts, not current execution captures.
Independent Quality re-review and owner acceptance of this release are NOT RUN. Integration independently passed implementation 8c5178e; the exact release SHA has separate local verification.
